description: This file provides platform-specific implementations of time-related functions such as gettimeofday, clock_gettime, and gmtime_r for Windows, including conversions between Windows system time and POSIX time.

methods.name: gettimeofday
methods.description: Retrieves the current time of day, converting Windows system time to POSIX timeval structure.

methods.name: clock_gettime
methods.description: Provides clock time for CLOCK_REALTIME and CLOCK_MONOTONIC clocks on Windows.

methods.name: gmtime_r
methods.description: Converts a time_t value to a tm structure in a thread-safe manner using Windows gmtime_s.
